top_signals.title: NMDC Expands Fleet with Heavy-Duty Dredger Newbuild
top_signals.summary: Abu Dhabi-based NMDC Group has inaugurated its new Abu Al Bakhoush heavy-duty cutter suction dredger in Nantong, China, expanding its fleet of more than 170 vessels and strengthening its capacity for offshore and marine infrastructure projects.Built by Jiangsu Haixin Shipping Heavy Industry…

top_signals.title: Joint Statement at the second meeting of the EU-China Trade and Investment Consultations
